thought.text: Ketemu endpoint aslinya. Sekarang saya lihat bagaimana captcha dikirim ke `email-registration`.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/main.js',errors='ignore').read()
for kw in ['email-registration','captchaResponse','captchaToken','captcha','siteKey']:
    idxs=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(kw),s)][:4]
    for i in idxs:
        frag=s[max(0,i-260):i+260]
        frag=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',frag)
        print(f"[{kw}] ...{frag}...")
        print()
    print("="*70)
PY
